SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name FROM artists AS T1 JOIN songs AS T2 ON T1.artist_id  =  T2.artist_id WHERE T2.song_title  =  "Badlands"
SELECT T1.name FROM Highschooler AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING count(*)  >=  3
SELECT customer_id ,  first_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN ( SELECT customer_id FROM credit_cards )
SELECT date_customer_added FROM customers WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 10 AND 20
SELECT document_id FROM Documents WHERE document_budget_description  =  'Government'

SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name FROM teachers AS T1 JOIN teaches AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id  =  T2.teacher_id JOIN students AS T3 ON T2.class_id  =  T3.class_id GROUP BY T1.teacher_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.driver_id ,  T1.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN laptimes AS T2 ON T1.driver_id  =  T2.driver_id WHERE T2.milliseconds  >  100000
SELECT T1.part_name ,  count(*) FROM Parts AS T1 JOIN Assets AS T2 ON T1.part_id  =  T2.part_id GROUP BY T1.part_name
SELECT T1.name FROM film_studio AS T1 JOIN film AS T2 ON T1.studio_id  =  T2.studio_id GROUP BY T1.studio_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT college) FROM player WHERE team  =  'Columbus Crew'
SELECT T1.mountain_id ,  T1.name FROM mountain AS T1 JOIN photo AS T2 ON T1.mountain_id  =  T2.mountain_id GROUP BY T1.mountain_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2
SELECT count(*) FROM Has_allergy AS T1 JOIN Allergy AS T2 ON T1.allergy_code  =  T2.allergy_code WHERE T2.allergy_name  =  "cat"
SELECT count(*) FROM country WHERE language != "English"
SELECT air_date FROM episodes WHERE title  =  "A Love of a Lifetime"
SELECT Allergy_Type ,  count(*) FROM Has_Allergy GROUP BY Allergy_Type
SELECT count(*) FROM budget_codes
SELECT phone_number FROM Person AS T1 JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.person_id  =  T2.person_id WHERE T1.first_name  =  "Nancy" AND T1.last_name  =  "Edwards"
SELECT T1.name FROM swimmer AS T1 JOIN record AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.swimmer_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING count(*)  >=  2
